sentences.text: Your phone knows where it is, to within a few meters, using satellites twelve thousand miles overhead.
sentences.spoken: Your phone knows where it is, to within a few meters, using satellites twelve thousand miles overhead.

sentences.text: The trick is a clock. {shows}Every GPS satellite carries an atomic clock, and broadcasts exactly what time it is.
sentences.spoken: The trick is a clock. Every GPS satellite carries an atomic clock, and broadcasts exactly what time it is.

sentences.text: Your phone receives the signal a moment later, and measures the delay. {delay_marks}
sentences.spoken: Your phone receives the signal a moment later, and measures the delay.

sentences.text: The signal travels at the speed of light — a defined constant, two hundred ninety nine million seven hundred ninety two thousand four hundred fifty eight meters every second. {formula_lands}{eq_shown}
sentences.spoken: The signal travels at the speed of light — a defined constant, two hundred ninety nine million seven hundred ninety two thousand four hundred fifty eight meters every second.

sentences.text: Distance equals that speed times the delay. {equation_lands}So one satellite gives one distance — a sphere around it. {sphere_grows}
sentences.spoken: Distance equals that speed times the delay. So one satellite gives one distance — a sphere around it.

sentences.text: Three spheres intersect in one point. {spheres_close}That is where you are. {spot_pins}
sentences.spoken: Three spheres intersect in one point. That is where you are.

sentences.text: But your phone's clock is not atomic. {clock_gap}So a fourth satellite corrects it — solving position and time together. {fourth_draws}
sentences.spoken: But your phone's clock is not atomic. So a fourth satellite corrects it — solving position and time together.

sentences.text: Four satellites, one clock trick, and geometry: {recap_stack}that is how GPS knows where you are.
sentences.spoken: Four satellites, one clock trick, and geometry: that is how GPS knows where you are.
